research_closure.track_name: Domain C: Perpetual Funding & Delta-Neutral Carry Research
research_closure.data_authenticity_status: 100% SHA-256 verified from official Binance Vision archives (BTC, ETH, SOL).
reproducible_findings: 1. Market regimes (Trend, Volatility, Momentum) provide statistically significant descriptive market context.
2. Point-in-time funding rates exhibit autocorrelation (AR(3) R2_OOS ~70%), but directional spread is small.
3. Multi-asset funding spreads exhibit rapid mean reversion (median persistence < 8 to 16 hours).
4. Isolated margin carry strategies survive bull rallies ONLY when backed by 62.5% unhedged cash reserves.
rejected_strategies: H1-H7: Technical breakout and session continuation strategies (all net negative after taker fees).
B3/B5: Exhaustion reversals (statistically indistinguishable from noise).
CS1-CS4: Cross-sectional momentum / funding ranking strategies (overwhelmed by rebalancing turnover).
CP1-CP4: Tactical capital preservation rules (underperformed static 50/50 allocation).
RC1-RC3: Regime-conditional switching carry (negative incremental return due to churn costs).
statistically_interesting_but_economical: Funding Rate Predictability AR(3): Out-of-sample explanatory power confirmed (p < 0.001), but roundtrip switching cost (19-36 bps) is 17x to 68x higher than avoided negative funding (-0.28 bps).
Cross-Asset Funding Arbitrage: Switching hurdle of 38 bps Maker / 72 bps Taker exceeds observed spread duration.
hypothetical_margin_assumptions_rejected: Retail Portfolio Margin: Standard accounts cannot cross-margin Spot and USDⓈ-M without VIP 4+ ($10M+) enrollment.
Zero Liquidation Risk Carry: Debunked; cash exhaustion in rallies leads to margin calls under isolated margin.
research_closure.closure_rationale: Over a 14-month authentic period (425 days), safe unleveraged carry (Structure B) generated +313 to +338 USDT, underperforming risk-free 3-Month US Treasury Bills (+610.88 USDT) by -$272 to -$297 USDT. Aggressive carry (Structure A) suffered margin calls, depleted cash reserves, and beat sovereign debt by merely +15 to +66 USDT (< 50 bps annualized risk premium). Incurring crypto exchange insolvency, stablecoin de-pegging, and smart contract risks for a sub-50 bps spread is economically irrational. All 23 research artifacts and datasets are preserved for auditability. CBE engineering resources are formally transitioned from strategy backtesting to pure market intelligence.

model_reliability_audit.nominal_expectation: Nominal 80.00% empirical coverage across matured candles.
model_reliability_audit.root_cause_analysis: Underlying Gaussian / parametric error assumption fails under crypto fat tails and volatility clustering. Fixed width intervals do not expand sufficiently during regime shifts.
model_reliability_audit.current_operational_risk: HIGH: Users relying on 80% interval will experience 1.8x more boundary breaches than claimed.
model_reliability_audit.recalibration_path: Implement Split Conformal Prediction or empirical quantile conformalization in Sprint 10.01.

model_reliability_audit.nominal_expectation: Nominal 95.00% empirical coverage across matured candles.
model_reliability_audit.root_cause_analysis: Heavy tail events and jump processes exceed parametric bounds in high-volatility regimes.
model_reliability_audit.current_operational_risk: HIGH: Out-of-bounds market moves occur in 21% of bars instead of the expected 5%.
model_reliability_audit.recalibration_path: Calibrate conformal non-conformity scores over a rolling 2,000-bar calibration window.

model_reliability_audit.nominal_expectation: Monotonic reliability diagram with Brier score < 0.20.
model_reliability_audit.observed_performance: Weak separation in 40-60% probability bin; Brier score ~0.245 (barely beats 0.25 null coin-flip).
model_reliability_audit.root_cause_analysis: Model outputs cluster near prior probabilities without strong discriminative alpha.
model_reliability_audit.current_operational_risk: MEDIUM: Users may interpret 55% as a directional forecast when it reflects uncertainty.
model_reliability_audit.recommended_product_action: READY_FOR_DISPLAY (With explicit Brier score and confidence caveats).
model_reliability_audit.recalibration_path: Apply isotonic regression or Platt scaling on out-of-fold predictions in Sprint 10.01.

model_reliability_audit.nominal_expectation: Empirical, dynamic tail risk likelihood conditioned on volatility regime.
model_reliability_audit.observed_performance: Static fallback constants (0.05 tail, 0.01 jump) under Degraded / Spot-Only mode.
model_reliability_audit.root_cause_analysis: Derived from hardcoded constants when derivatives/orderbook streams are offline.
model_reliability_audit.current_operational_risk: CRITICAL_IF_UNLABELED: False impression of quantitative risk estimation.
model_reliability_audit.recalibration_path: Explicitly label as 'Statik Tahmin / Fallback' in UI; do not present as empirical model output.

model_reliability_audit.observed_performance: High serial dependence; 1h and 4h intervals overlap strongly with 15m errors.
model_reliability_audit.root_cause_analysis: Overlapping return windows share identical intrabar shocks (multi-horizon lookahead autocorrelation).
model_reliability_audit.current_operational_risk: LOW_TO_MEDIUM: Can inflate perceived statistical confidence if treated as independent.
model_reliability_audit.recalibration_path: Display effective sample size (N_eff = N / Horizon_Bars) alongside all metrics.

Araştırma Kapanış Kararı: Sprints 09.20 - 09.42 boyunca yürütülen delta-neutral carry ve vadeli fonlama araştırma programı, test edilen tüm varsayımlar altında iktisadi olarak cazip bulunmayarak resmen ARŞİVLENMİŞTİR. 14 aylık (425 gün) otik veride, risksiz ABD Hazine Bonoları 10k sermayeye +610,88 USDT kazandırırken; güvenli carry +313 ila +338 USDT üreterek bonoların gerisinde kalmış, agresif carry ise nakit rezervlerini tüketip marjin çağrısı yiyerek bonoları yıllık bazda yalnızca %0,13 ila %0,57 geçebilmiştir. Borsa iflası ve stablecoin de-peg riskleri göz önüne alındığında getiri yetersizdir. Araştırma artefaktları korunarak mühendislik odağı tamamen güvenilir bir piyasa istihbarat ürününe yönlendirilmiştir.
2. İlk Ürün Tanımı (CBE Market Intelligence — MVP): CBE, otomatik işlem yapmayan, şeffaf, açıklanabilir ve kalibre edilmiş bir piyasa istihbaratı gösterge paneli ve API ürünü olarak yapılandırılmaktadır. Önerilen 10 modülden 7'si doğrudan kullanıma hazırdır (READY_NOW).
3. Model Güvenilirlik Denetimi: Nominal %80 ve %95 tahmin aralıklarının ampirik olarak sırasıyla %64,24 ve %78,94 kapsama sağladığı (yaklaşık %15-16 eksik kapsama / undercoverage) doğrulanmıştır. Sprint 10.01'de Conformal Prediction (uyumlu tahmin) katmanı ile aralıklar ampirik olarak kalibre edilecektir.
4. Ürün Mimarisi: Mevcut Python standart kütüphane HTTP sunucusu ve vanilla JS arayüzü son derece hafiftir (< 150 MB RAM, aylık < $10 VPS maliyeti). Veritabanı kilitleme darboğazı olmaksızın 500+ eşzamanlı kullanıcıyı desteklemektedir. Yeniden yazım gerekmemektedir.
5. Yol Haritası ve Çıkış Kriterleri: Sprint 10.01 ile 10.06 arasında 6 odaklı sprint tanımlanmış ve 9 ölçülebilir kabul kapısı (Release Acceptance Gates) belirlenmiştir. APPROVAL4 = FALSE ve 29/29 dondurma bütünlüğü korunmaktadır.
